total-budget.fcdo:narrative: Collated Planning Budgets: Please note that FCDO’s Official Development Assistance (ODA) budget for the financial years of 2026/27, 2027/28 and 2028/29 has not yet been allocated. In line with the UK Government controls for financial planning, the FCDO can commit up to a proportion of possible future budgets in the financial years beyond this spending review period. This allows the FCDO the flexibility to respond to changing global needs, including humanitarian crises, and fluctuations in future ODA allocations. For these financial years the FCDO has provided figures that are based on an aggregation of current programme planning budgets. This is made up of both approved and pipeline programme plans, but does not reflect expected allocations. This is shared with the intention of making FCDO’s future spending plans for ODA more accessible and will be updated when ODA allocations are finalised. For the most up to date information on FCDO’s confirmed and indicative budgets, please see our latest Annual Report and Accounts.

title.narrative: FCDO annual report and accounts 2024 to 2025

description.narrative:
The Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office (FCDO) annual report and accounts provides detail on the activities of the FCDO during financial year 2024 to 2025. The report consists of a performance report, an accountability report and financial statements.
The financial statements and certain sections of the accountability report are audited by the National Audit Office before they are presented to Parliament. The report was laid in Parliament on 22 July 2025.

title.narrative: FCDO International Programme spend objectives 2023 to 2024

description.narrative:
These documents set out the main objectives of themes funded through the FCDO’s International Programme.
The International Programme, previously known as ‘strategic and bilateral programmes’ and ‘FCO departmental programmes’ came to a close at the end of financial year 2023 to 2024.

FCDO is committed to making evaluations public. The dataset includes published evaluations of FCDO’s programmes and corresponding management responses.
The evaluations use a range of methodological approaches, covering various themes and geographical areas.

title.narrative: FCDO Official Development Assistance programme allocations 2026–2027 to 2028–2029: equality impact assessment

description.narrative: This assessment details the anticipated impacts on equalities of the proposed Official Development Assistance (ODA) allocations for financial years 2026–2027 to 2028–2029. Where possible, it assesses whether overall allocation decisions disproportionately affect people according to protected and relevant characteristics. It sets out the actions taken by ministers to mitigate against possible disproportionate negative equality impacts.

title.narrative: FCDO Official Development Assistance programme allocations 2025 to 2026: equality impact assessment

description.narrative: This assessment details the anticipated impacts on equalities of the proposed Official Development Assistance (ODA) allocations for financial year 2025 to 2026 before they are finalised. The assessment aggregates the total expected impacts on equalities based on ministerial decisions taken throughout the allocations process and sets out mitigations to aid current and future decision-making.
